name: Income Borg El Arab Data Center
notes: Planned multi-phase data center in Borg El Arab, about 52 km southwest of Alexandria; report says Ministry of Electricity would initially provide 100 MW, rising to 400 MW in future phases, and completion is expected to take three years.

name: Khazna-Benya Maadi Technology Park Hyperscale Data Center
notes: USD 250m hyperscale project at Maadi Technology Park; MoU secured land, construction was expected to start later in 2023 with completion targeted within three years.

name: GPX Cairo 2 Expansion
notes: Expansion of GPX Cairo 2 adds 12 MW of power, 1,800 racks, and 9,000 m2; phase one of expansion was stated as customer-ready in late Q3 2026.

name: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub Phase 2
notes: Telecom Egypt announced RDH phase 2 in Smart Village availability zone in 2023, targeting up to 7.1 MW IT load; ECG project page checked 2026-08-11 lists RDH2 as completed with 4.9 MW IT load and 510 racks. Greater Cairo market; source location is Egypt/Smart Village.

name: Telecom Egypt Regional Data Hub Smart Village Campus
notes: Telecom Egypt says RDH phase one launched in Q1 2021 and was fully utilized; phase two raises capacity and future Smart Village availability-zone phases are planned to reach up to 16.3 MW IT load. Capacity recorded as stated future campus total.

name: Data Centers at the New Administrative Capital
notes: Official Orascom project page checked 2026-08-11 says it is building two data centers in the New Administrative Capital, including a Tier 3 38,000 m2 facility plus 133-rack and 1,088-rack data centers to serve the capital city; MW not disclosed.

name: Hassan Allam Digital Infrastructure Data Center Project
developer: Hassan Allam Digital Infrastructure and Data Centre Solutions / A15
notes: Egypt NTRA granted a license to establish and operate data centers and cloud services; trade press reports USD 400m initial first phase. Location not yet specified publicly; included under Cairo because the licensing ceremony and quoted ministry/regulator context were in Cairo, but exact governorate should be rechecked when announced. Capacity from contemporaneous industry reports; primary article did not disclose MW.

name: EgyptNetwork Data Center
notes: Listings identify an operational colocation data center at 24 Om Kolthom St, Mansoura, operated by EgyptNetwork; capacity not supplied. Aggregator evidence only.
